Package com.oracle.database.selectai.agent

Interface Agent

public interface Agent
Contract for Select AI agent lifecycle management and metadata access.

A Select AI agent is a database-side resource managed by the DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT PL/SQL package. Agents can use a configured Select AI profile and may participate in task, tool, and team orchestration.

An Agent instance can represent an existing database agent or be configured for creation. The name-only SelectAIAgent.agent(String) factory verifies that the agent exists and loads its metadata and attributes before returning. SelectAIAgent.listAgents() also returns handles with loaded metadata and attributes. A handle configured for creation is obtained with SelectAIAgent.agent(String, AgentAttributes, String, AgentStatus).

A creation-configured handle retains its supplied attributes, description, and status without querying the database. Only such a handle can call create(); after creation succeeds, it becomes database-backed. enable(), disable(), and drop(boolean) require an existing agent and operate on the database-side resource.

Before creation, getStatus() and getAgentAttributes() return the configured values. For a database-backed handle, each call to either method queries the database. getStatus() does not change the description returned by getDescription(). The description is supplied or loaded when the handle is initialized; getDescription() does not query the database.

Agent names and a non-null attributes object are checked locally. Required values within AgentAttributes, including the profile name and role, are validated by the database during create(). Loading metadata and executing lifecycle operations require database access and privileges.

For a complete runnable example, see CreateAgentSample source.

1.1.0

  • Method Details

    • create

      boolean create() throws SelectAIException
      Creates this creation-configured agent in the database. For a runnable example, see CreateAgentSample source.
      Returns:
      true when the database creates the agent
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when this handle was loaded from an existing agent
      SelectAIException - when the database rejects or cannot complete the operation

    • enable

      boolean enable() throws SelectAIException
      Enables this database-backed agent. For a runnable example, see EnableAgentSample source.
      Returns:
      true when the database enables the agent
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when this agent has not been created
      SelectAIException - when the database operation fails

    • disable

      boolean disable() throws SelectAIException
      Disables this database-backed agent. For a runnable example, see DisableAgentSample source.
      Returns:
      true when the database disables the agent
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when this agent has not been created
      SelectAIException - when the database operation fails

    • drop

      boolean drop(boolean force) throws SelectAIException
      Drops this database-backed agent. When force is true, the operation may be retried after the handle has already been dropped; the database force-drop semantics determine the result. For a runnable example, see DropAgentSample source.
      Parameters:
      force - database force-drop option
      Returns:
      true when the drop completes
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when force is false and this agent has not been created
      SelectAIException - when the database operation fails

    • setAttribute

      boolean setAttribute(String attributeName, String attributeValue) throws SelectAIException
      Updates one agent attribute in the database.

      The database validates the attribute name and value for the selected database release. A null string value is passed to the database as SQL NULL; whether that clears an attribute is database-defined.

      Parameters:
      attributeName - database agent attribute name
      attributeValue - string value, or null where supported
      Returns:
      true when the update succeeds
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when attributeName is null or blank
      IllegalStateException - when this agent has not been created
      SelectAIException - when the database update fails
      See Also:
      • SetAgentAttributeSample source

    • setAttribute

      boolean setAttribute(String attributeName, boolean attributeValue) throws SelectAIException

      attributeValue - boolean value
      Returns:
      true when the update succeeds
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when attributeName is null or blank
      IllegalStateException - when this agent has not been created
      SelectAIException - when the database update fails

    • setAttribute

      boolean setAttribute(String attributeName, Integer attributeValue) throws SelectAIException

    • setAttributes

      boolean setAttributes(AgentAttributes agentAttributes) throws SelectAIException
      Updates multiple agent attributes in one database operation. For a runnable example, see SetAgentAttributesSample source.

      The payload is serialized as the JSON document accepted by DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT.SET_ATTRIBUTES. Values omitted from the payload are handled according to the database package semantics.

      Parameters:
      agentAttributes - agent attributes to update
      Returns:
      true when the update succeeds
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when agentAttributes is null
      IllegalStateException - when this agent has not been created
      SelectAIException - when the database update fails

    • getAgentName

      String getAgentName()
      Returns the database-reported name for a loaded agent, or the configured name before creation. This method does not access the database. For a runnable example, see LoadAgentSample source.
      Returns:
      configured or database-reported agent name

    • getDescription

      String getDescription()
      Returns the description supplied or loaded when this handle was initialized. This method does not access the database and the value is not changed by getStatus(). For a runnable example, see LoadAgentSample source.
      Returns:
      supplied or loaded agent description, or null when absent

    • getStatus

      AgentStatus getStatus() throws SelectAIException
      Returns the configured status before creation or the current database status for an existing agent. A pending agent with no configured status returns null. This method does not change the description. For a runnable example, see LoadAgentSample source.
      Returns:
      configured or current agent status
      Throws:
      SelectAIException - when current agent metadata cannot be fetched

    • getAgentAttributes

      AgentAttributes getAgentAttributes() throws SelectAIException
      Returns agent attributes for this handle.

      For a database-backed agent, this method reloads the attributes from the database on each call and therefore can fail if the resource was deleted. For a creation-configured agent, it returns the configured attributes without querying the database. For a runnable example, see LoadAgentSample source.

      Returns:
      current agent attributes for an existing agent, or configured attributes for an agent pending creation
      Throws:
      SelectAIException - when the agent no longer exists or current attributes cannot be fetched
